sectionGroups.title: Drilling Rig Power Unit Turnkey Service Project
sectionGroups.subtitle: The service provider purchases diesel engines and generator sets, deploys personnel to operate the equipment to provide power for rigs, and undertakes equipment operation and maintenance.

cards.title: Bozhou No.1 Drilling Company Power Unit Turnkey Service
cards.summary: CNPC Bohai Drilling Engineering Company power turnkey project. The project adopts an integrated turnkey model including equipment supply + installation & commissioning + on-site operation & maintenance + full-cycle maintenance. Customers are not required to invest in equipment procurement or operational manpower costs, achieving full-process managed power assurance and effectively helping customers focus on their core drilling business.
